standards_bodies.name: Recreational Scuba Training Council Europe
standards_bodies.notes: A council of European diver training agencies that publishes minimum training standards its members follow. It does not issue diver certifications: a card marked RSTC is issued by the member agency. Formed in 1994. A separate council, RSTC (United States), covers US agencies; both belong to the WRSTC.

standards_bodies.name: European Underwater Federation
standards_bodies.notes: A federation of European diver training organisations. Its EUF Certification International scheme, administered by Austrian Standards, audits training organisations against the ISO/EN recreational diving standards (ISO 24801, ISO 24802 and related). It does not issue diver certifications: a certified agency's card can carry the EUF mark and certificate number, but the card is the agency's.
